# PlaybackMode

[Toolkit](README.md) · `DotGame.Toolkit.Animation` · enum

```csharp
public enum PlaybackMode
```

How a [`SpriteAnimation`](SpriteAnimation.md) or a [`Tween<T>`](Tween.md) plays.

## Values

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| <a name="loop"></a>`Loop` | From its start to its end, and over again: 0 1 2 3 0 1 2 3 ... |
| <a name="once"></a>`Once` | From its start to its end once, then it holds its end and finishes. |
| <a name="pingpong"></a>`PingPong` | From its start to its end, back again, and over again: 0 1 2 3 2 1 0 1 ... A sprite animation's end frames aren't repeated. |
